annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously specifies that, for any response with an SVCB-compatible QTYPE, a resolver should treat all records in the Additional section as if they had a SOURCE PREFIX-LENGTH of zero and a SCOPE PREFIX-LENGTH equal to the value provided in the ECS option. The wording does not leave room for materially different implementation behaviours, nor does it omit a concrete constraint that would prevent a unique operational interpretation.
